title: The ferry
logline: Tuesday. The ferry. The suit on its hanger in the back window, airing. A kid on the car deck asks if it's a costume. Wood says yes. The sketchbook opens for the first time on the trip: the Sound, two lines.

panels.composition: A ferry's car deck in blinding light. The Legacy between two clean SUVs, the wool suit on a hanger in its back window. WOOD at the rail. Puget Sound cerulean.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink with pristine architectural perspective, blinding clear summer light in soft cerulean and pale linen watercolor, a ferry car deck in bright summer light with a faded green station wagon parked between two gleaming SUVs, a dark wool suit hanging in its rear window, a thin man at the rail, blue water

panels.composition: A KID, eight, at the Legacy's window, looking at the suit. Wood beside him.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink with pristine architectural perspective, blinding clear summer light in soft cerulean and pale linen watercolor, a child peering at a wool suit hanging in a station wagon's rear window while a thin man answers him

panels.composition: The sketchbook, open on the rail. Two lines: the horizon and an island. Nothing else. The first drawing of the trip.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink with pristine architectural perspective, blinding clear summer light in soft cerulean and pale linen watercolor, close-up of a sketchbook open on a ferry rail with only two ink lines on the page, a horizon and an island

panels.composition: The ferry from the water, small, on the Sound, the islands ahead. Light. The strip lets the light be the whole panel.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink with pristine architectural perspective, blinding clear summer light in soft cerulean and pale linen watercolor, a ferry small on brilliant blue water with forested islands ahead in blinding summer light, no words

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: 'A guest.' Two lines on the rail.
